g.text: Robot deployment framework for cleaning services
A customer job becomes declared sub-tasks, decisions over the team's evidenced capabilities, and a conditional job plan
Declared work requirement: 3 rooms, 3 whiteboards with a marked
region, 2 glass partitions, 3 wall spots, 1 supply request.
Sub-task requests: capability, domain, context and target, allowed
modes, accepted evidence levels, exact settings, owner-authorised
force range, metric bounds, required human roles, inputs from other
Live facts at decision time: shared
Over the register: SELECT, CONFIRM, ASK, WAIT,
WITHHOLD or REFUSE, with every option's
Optimised allocation, scheduling and fleet sizing from
Robot and setting per sub-task, required human roles and actions, open owner choices, pending confirmations,
waits, and blocked sub-tasks with the missing evidence named.
